timeline.title: Full-Stack Engineer
timeline.summary: Secure services, connected workflows, and better delivery for post-trade operations.
highlights: Build Java/Spring services and secure APIs, integrating internal bank platforms and legacy processing.
Partner with product and business users on BigQuery and Looker Studio analytics.
Led the move from legacy release scripts to configurable Jenkins pipelines for builds, tests, security scans, and deployments.

timeline.title: Full-Stack Engineer
timeline.summary: Reusable data platforms, event-driven systems, and tools that make operations clearer.
highlights: Owned the architecture of a modular, configuration-driven Spring Batch synchronization product.
Contributed to real-time ETL with event ordering, acknowledgments, retries, and transactional controls.
Built reusable Grafana dashboards, Geneos alerting, and a secure file-retrieval service with a React frontend.

timeline.title: Software Developer & DevOps Engineer
timeline.summary: Regulatory reporting across the Americas, with automation that turned week-long analysis into hours.
highlights: Built a distributed regression-analysis platform using Jenkins and multithreaded Spring Boot, reducing analysis from one week to three hours.
Delivered Java/Drools reporting functionality for CFTC, SEC, and Canadian regulators.
Built modular delivery pipelines, refactored legacy applications, and supported production systems.

timeline.summary: Mathematical modeling and R programming applied to hydrological and spatial problems.

timeline.title: Bachelor of Science

caseStudies.title: A week of analysis. Three hours instead.
caseStudies.description: Designed an automated platform that distributed large datasets across parallel Jenkins pipelines, then aggregated the results in a multithreaded Spring Boot application.
caseStudies.preview: Parallel pipelines and a multithreaded backend transformed large regression cycles.

caseStudies.title: From a blank page to platform parity.
caseStudies.description: Co-architected a working platform proof of concept under a limited timeline: a React frontend, configuration-driven APIs, an authentication gateway, and an in-product AI assistant.
highlights: Achieved 100% output parity with the existing platform for one selected trade type during the defined evaluation period.
Built a configuration-driven query API exposing high-dimensional datasets (100+ columns) as filterable, sortable endpoints without repetitive per-endpoint code.
Components were later identified for reuse by other teams, and its data-query logic was adapted for BigQuery/Looker Studio dashboards.
caseStudies.preview: Co-architected a multi-service proof of concept, from secure APIs to the React interface.
caseStudies.outcomeLabel: One selected trade type · defined evaluation period

caseStudies.title: An assistant that knows the context.
caseStudies.description: Built an assistant that understands active filters, table metadata, and displayed results, so users can ask product questions without copying data between tools.
highlights: Backend AI service on Spring AI connected to the enterprise AI platform, supporting JSON and streamed (SSE) responses.
Selected and structured context to avoid unnecessary token and context-window usage.
Extracted the frontend and backend assistant components for reuse and shared them with an interested partner team.
caseStudies.preview: Brought AI into the product, with live UI state and streamed answers.

caseStudies.title: Configure once. Reuse across use cases.
caseStudies.description: Owned the architecture of a configuration-driven synchronization product supporting multiple use cases without duplicate implementations. Mentored a developer onto the project.
caseStudies.preview: A modular Spring Batch product for data transfer and synchronization.

caseStudies.title: Making AI useful across teams.
caseStudies.description: Built an enterprise engineering harness connecting source control, work tracking, documentation, delivery, and logs. Helped teams adopt it through practical training.
highlights: Authored shared instructions and reusable agent skills to improve consistency and results.
Delivered training on prompting, models, tokens, context windows, agent skills, and MCP.
Onboarded my own team and engineers from surrounding teams.
caseStudies.preview: Reusable agent skills, engineering workflows, and hands-on training.

caseStudies.title: Secure access. Less waiting.
caseStudies.description: Designed and owned a Spring Boot file-retrieval application with Spring Security, a React frontend, and a daily cache to reduce repeated filesystem traversal.
caseStudies.preview: A production file-retrieval service with a React frontend and backend access controls.

caseStudies.title: Keep the data moving. Keep the order.
caseStudies.description: Contributed to a configurable ETL application using Java 21, Spring Integration, Solace, and PostgreSQL. Preserved lifecycle-event ordering with acknowledgments, retries, and transactional controls.
caseStudies.preview: Real-time trading-data processing with deliberate reliability controls.
